title: Amazon Transcribe
description: Amazon Transcribe options for streamed meetings, Virtual Participants and uploads.
appliesText: Applies to meetings, Virtual Participants and uploads started after the save; a meeting or an upload already started keeps its options.

languageCode.title: Language
languageCode.description: The meeting language, or identify-language / identify-multiple-languages to detect it.

languageOptions.title: Language options
languageOptions.description: With language identification, the comma-separated languages to choose from; uploads need at least two language options.

preferredLanguage.title: Preferred language
preferredLanguage.description: With language identification, the language to prefer; one of the language options. Not used by uploads.

contentRedactionEnabled.title: Redact personal information
contentRedactionEnabled.description: Redact the entity types below. Only for en-US, en-AU, en-GB and es-US; not with language identification.

piiEntityTypes.title: Entity types to redact
piiEntityTypes.description: Comma-separated Amazon Transcribe PII entity types, such as NAME,EMAIL,PHONE.

customVocabularyName.title: Custom vocabulary
customVocabularyName.description: An Amazon Transcribe custom vocabulary in this account and region, or empty for none.

customLanguageModelName.title: Custom language model
customLanguageModelName.description: An Amazon Transcribe custom language model for this language, or empty. Not with language identification.

showSpeakerLabel.title: Identify speakers within a channel by default
showSpeakerLabel.description: Label voices within one channel (spk_0, spk_1) when the client does not choose.
